summary: Verified batch of 6 fixes for Populus. Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_comment_reply_delete.py with 9 tests — all PASS (DELETE /api/comments/{id} owner-only, 404/403, cascade replies; DELETE /api/replies/{id} same; /users/me/blocks + /users/{id}/block flow). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844, chat_a login via token injection since email tab is disabled in UI): FAIDE tab icon glyph confirmed as Ionicons 'scale' (u+F553, glyphmap value 62803) — NOT flame. Feud detail transition (/feud/A → /feud/B via direct navigation) shows no stale A content (mid-transition body was empty then B rendered) — reset effect on `id` works. Comment delete UI: posted TEST_delete_ui_comment, trash icon `comment-delete-<id>` appeared on own comment, web confirm dialog auto-accepted, DELETE /comments/{id} fired, comment removed from list without page reload. Home preview pct updates confirmed visually — after voting on a card from detail, returning to Home shows 100%/0% on that card (previously hidden). Blocked-users section on profile fully working: empty state 'Non hai bloccato nessun utente.' shown, blocking chat_b via API then reloading profile → row with SBLOCCA button appears, tapping SBLOCCA removes row and GET /users/me/blocks returns empty blocked_users. HYPE-on-focus auto-refresh could NOT be end-to-end verified on the web preview because expo-router on web unmounts the Home screen when switching tabs, causing `selected` state to reset to 'all' on return; the code path itself (isHype bypasses 3s throttle) reviewed and looks correct — will work on native builds. chat_a nickname is 'chat_a' (unchanged), no reset needed.
action_items: HYPE auto-refresh on focus (index.tsx useFocusEffect isHype branch) cannot be fully verified on the web preview because expo-router unmounts the tab screen, resetting `selected` back to 'all'. On native this should work. If desired to also make it web-friendly, set `unmountOnBlur:false` and `freezeOnBlur:false` in tabs screenOptions or persist `selected` in AsyncStorage.
critical_code_review_comments: delete_comment cascades replies via db.replies.delete_many({comment_id}) BEFORE deleting the comment — correct order, prevents orphan replies.
delete_reply only removes the reply; parent comment's `reply_count` on subsequent GET is recomputed on-the-fly from the replies collection filtered by current vote side, so no stale counters.

success_rate.frontend: 5/6 verified end-to-end; HYPE focus refetch code-reviewed only due to web tab remount

seed_data_creation: None. Test comments/replies created during tests were deleted by the tests themselves; one TEST_delete_ui_comment posted via UI was deleted via the trash icon; chat_a briefly blocked chat_b and then unblocked (net zero).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Email login is hidden in UI (AUTH_EMAIL_ENABLED=false in /app/frontend/app/auth.tsx). To login as chat_a/chat_b in Playwright, call POST /api/auth/login via page.evaluate and localStorage.setItem('faide_token', JSON.stringify(token)). Ionicons glyph for 'scale' is u+F553 (62803). Home tab remounts on web when switching tabs, resetting `selected` state — keep this in mind when testing per-category focus behaviors.
